prompt_brief.positive: Terra Chronicle environment shoreline tile set, cohesive premium fantasy farming world, warm hand-painted storybook texture, top-down/isometric readable game tiles, gentle blue-green river water, wet sand and mossy grass bank, subtle foam and translucent shallows, artisanal painterly detail, seamless tileable edges, soft natural lighting, high-end interactive art game environment, consistent with Terra environment reference cluster.
prompt_brief.set_generation_instruction: Generate the whole shoreline set together as one coherent tile family: base water, shallow water, four cardinal edges, four diagonal edges, inner corner, outer corner. Use image-to-image or reference-guided generation from the environment contact sheet and current tile context; do not prompt from scratch if references are available.
prompt_brief.negative: no cyberpunk, no neon, no plastic UI gloss, no photorealistic water photo, no cheap mobile-game icon outline, no sticker look, no hard black border, no noisy high-frequency texture, no mismatched anime character art, no isolated full-scene illustration, no unreadable miniature details, no magenta/pink fringe.

candidate_workflow.selection_rule: Select best 1-2 per target only after direct visual review at both source size and in-game tile scale.
candidate_workflow.processing_rule: After selection, crop/resize/export alpha PNGs; check seams, alpha fringe, and tile-scale readability before any live integration.
